question: Which city is going to host the 2026 winter Olympics?
solution:
The correct answer is __**Milan-Cortina d'Ampezzo.**__

 [IMAGE: https://cdn.repeatermock.com/tb/36f36cd5ece4186095afcf2ffbfb7b80cc04b6c2e3226e7477a419a9fbc96f85.png] **__Key Points__**

__
 
• **Milan-Cortina d'Ampezzo:-**

 
 
• It won the bid to host the 2026 winter Olympics after defeating the only other contender, Stockholm-Are, in a vote by IOC members.
 
• Milan-Cortina d'Ampezzo is a joint bid by the Italian cities of Milan and Cortina d'Ampezzo, and it will be the first time that Italy will host the winter Olympics since Turin in 2006.
 
 

 [IMAGE: https://cdn.repeatermock.com/tb/f13e2ad6582c16aa62a83672e2547ad20a01fddb61962a1acce42eb9a1a99caa.png] **Additional Information__**

 
• **Beijing:-**

 
 
• It hosted the 2008 summer Olympics, was the host city for the 2022 winter Olympics, making it the first city to host both the summer and winter Olympics.
 
 
 
• **Boston:-**
 
 
• It was one of the initial contenders to host the 2024 summer Olympics, withdrew its bid in 2015 due to financial concerns.
